messages.subject: wordcloud pkg encoding in shinyapps.io
parts:
Hello.

I deplyed my shiny code with wordcloud package.

My local pc can shows perfectly but shinyapps show codes not characters.

My local one is window with no UTF-8, and other local is Ubuntu with UTF-8 both can shows good.

How can I fix it?


sample code
server.R

library(wordcloud)

function(input, output, session) {
  
  
  d1 <- c("강릉교동짬뽕","강릉선교장","강릉오죽헌","강문해변","경포대")
  d2 <- c(35,126,192,322,452)
  d3 <- data.frame(poi_name=d1, n=d2)
  spider_cloud <- d3
  
  output$spider_cloud <- renderPlot({
    wordcloud_tmp <- spider_cloud
    wordcloud(wordcloud_tmp$poi_name, freq=wordcloud_tmp$n,
              scale=c(5,1), rot.per=0,
              min.freq = 1, max.words=100,
              random.order=F, colors=brewer.pal(8, "Dark2"))
    
  })
}

ui.R
plotOutput("spider_cloud")

messages.author: 299a5089d6c6c523
messages.subject: Re: wordcloud pkg encoding in shinyapps.io
parts:
The locale of your shinyapps.io instance is the value detected by the rsconnect package when it constructs the manifest for the bundle that is uploaded.
And the encoding of the project is detected from the .Rproj file.

If you are certain that those values are proper, could you tell what your account name & application name are and I can look a little further.

When running locally, what is the output of devtools::session_info() and rsconnect::appDependencies() ?
